The chain for creating a memo runs frontend → gRPC/Connect proto → handler → store → dialect driver:

```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178      (useCreateMemo hook, calls memoServiceClient.createMemo at line 183)
web/src/connect.ts:197                   (memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport))
proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go:409   (MemoServiceHandler.CreateMemo — Connect RPC dispatch)
server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:306                (ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo → calls s.APIV1Service.CreateMemo)
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70                     (APIV1Service.CreateMemo — builds *store.Memo, calls s.Store.CreateMemo at line 115)
store/memo.go:109                                            (Store.CreateMemo — validates UID, delegates to s.driver.CreateMemo)
store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16                                   (DB.CreateMemo — builds and executes `INSERT INTO \`memo\` (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING ...` at line 41)
```

(Equivalent dialect drivers exist at `store/db/mysql/memo.go:16` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`, each performing the analogous `INSERT INTO memo ...` for their SQL dialect.)
